title: Unmasking Contextual Stereotypes: Measuring and Mitigating BERT's Gender Bias
benchmark_measurement: Gender bias (association with male vs. female terms) for the profession 'director of religious activities'.
findings: For the profession 'director of religious activities', the pre-trained English BERT model showed a male bias, associating it more strongly with male terms and negatively with female terms. After the debiasing fine-tuning procedure, this gender bias was reduced, with both male and female terms showing similar, slightly positive associations.
